visual_success_gate.reason: Several scenes still have wrong or missing manipulated-object/target masks or incoherent relation/action timing. Scaling to 100 scenes would measure known pipeline failures rather than validate a stable configuration.

Plate, target, support, and robot masks are usable; the final plate-on-target relation and action sequence are coherent.

recommended_global_revisions: Add a global RGB-based identity check for SAM candidate tracks so temporal persistence cannot prefer a wrong but persistent region.
Improve small/occluded manipulated-object handling without alternate prompts, episode aliases, or manual boxes/points.
Strengthen target-role extraction when the goal explicitly names a receptacle or destination while still allowing genuine null roles.
Add a global temporal-consistency review pass that flags, but does not fabricate, missing interaction actions and unsupported final relations.
